equation_or_statement: G_mn + Lambda g_mn = kappa_eff T_H_mn + DeltaE_res_mn
required_inputs: requires EH dominance and residual tensor mapped
impact: starts Newton calibration only after local operator side is controlled

equation_or_statement: In the same observed frame and nonrelativistic limit, G_00 ~= 2 nabla^2 Phi/c^2 and T_00 ~= rho_H c^2.
required_inputs: requires same-frame metric/readout and slow-source limit

equation_or_statement: nabla^2 Phi = (kappa_eff c^4/2) rho_H + Delta_Poisson = 4 pi G_eff rho_H + Delta_Poisson.
impact: this is the clean GR-to-Newton coefficient bridge

equation_or_statement: M_eff := k_M ell_M(J_H), rho_eff := k_M q_M where q_M is the local density of the projected charge current.
required_inputs: requires k_M source normalization from parent matter/source units
impact: ties 3753 topological charge to source density

equation_or_statement: For a closed source with zero residual flux, surface_integral grad Phi dot dS = 4 pi G_eff M_eff.
required_inputs: requires Delta_Poisson volume term and boundary/source residuals vanish or are bounded
impact: turns closed charge into exterior monopole

equation_or_statement: a_r=-partial_r Phi=-G_eff M_eff/r^2 + a_res, so mu_obs=G_eff M_eff + mu_extra.
required_inputs: requires slow-body geodesic limit and no fifth-force/source hair
impact: keeps measured GM separate from fitted readout

equation_or_statement: The numerical value of G_eff is not derived unless kappa_eff or k_M is predicted by the parent action; otherwise only universality and derivative silence can be claimed.
required_inputs: requires parent absolute coupling normalization to predict G itself
impact: matches how GR uses kappa rather than deriving measured G
